column1: # Chrome, through `just conformance`: where justify-items and justify-self place one item on the inline axis.
# Measured on Chrome Headless Shell 153.0.8010.12, the chromium Playwright pins here.
# A 200x100 relative container, `grid` with one 200px column, `block` or `flex`, holding one item.
# `box` is a block holding content `width` wide (a block child is itself that wide); `img` is a `width`x20 SVG.
# `dir` is stated on the page and inherited; `itemdir` is the item's own direction, `-` for inherited; an absolute
# item has no insets. `outer` is a chain of 200-wide block wrappers between the page and the container,
# outermost first and joined by `>`, each naming its justify-items or `-` for unset. `-` elsewhere is unset.
# x, w and h are the item from getBoundingClientRect, x from the container.
